clips.title: The story
paras: In the Valley of Trials, an initiate who loses the Earth Sapta can ask Canaga Earthcaller for another. The replacement gives the young shaman a chance to commune with the spirits of the land, along with a warning to guard sacred draughts carefully.

A misplaced Earth Sapta can interrupt an initiate's communion with the spirits of stone and soil. Prepared through specific rituals, the elemental brew thins the veil between the physical realm and the spirits. When an initiate loses or spills it while traveling through Durotar, Canaga Earthcaller prepares another in good faith, but warns the novice to guard sacred gifts with greater care.

Canaga Earthcaller watches over fledgling shamans emerging from the Den in the Valley of Trials. He understands that young orcs and trolls are prone to the chaos of early trials, but stresses that elemental spirits do not take kindly to negligence. Accepting a second sapta offers a small lesson in humility: power granted by the earth must be guarded and respected.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I give you one in good faith. You already proved yourself once, but me tinkin' you should be more careful in the future.
